title: Let the Sky Hold You for a Moment
core_idea: Looking up at the sky can widen perspective and soften worry; a simple practice of connection.
text: When was the last time you simply looked up? Not to check the weather, but to really look. The sky has a way of making our worries feel the right size again. Clouds drifting without effort. Stars that have been shining long before our troubles began. Some people find a kind of prayer in this, others just a moment of relief. Both are welcome here. Tonight, or tomorrow morning, step outside for one minute. Let your gaze rest on something far away. Breathe. Notice how the chest opens a little. Somewhere in that wide space, you may remember that you belong to something much larger.
description: A short reflection on looking up at the sky, and how it can widen perspective and gently soften worry.
